message.content:
Here's the brainstorm we settled on for the CSV export feature. Nothing else is written down, so treat this as the whole of it:

- Any staff user can export their own store's order history, never another store's.
- Default range is the last 12 months; anything older needs an explicit date range.
- Exports under 10,000 rows download synchronously; larger ranges get emailed a download link instead.
- Columns: order id, date, customer email, total, status.
- Built on the existing order-query service with a CSV writer added on top — no separate reporting pipeline.
- Done means a staff user gets a file immediately or an email with a link within a few minutes.

Turn it into an implementation plan.
